_comment: Maintainer paper corrections for the re-syncable data/questions.csv mirror (never hand-edited). build.js rewrites the `subject` of every row whose source URL base (value before any #page=N) matches a key here, before copies are grouped — so a whole coaching mock that was scraped under the wrong GS paper lands in the right bucket. Value = GS1 | GS2 | GS3 | GS4 | Essay. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
